title: Man with Roses and Car
coreRelationships: The man's dark attire and sunglasses create a stark contrast with the vibrant red roses and the teal car.
The open car door and overflowing roses suggest abundance and perhaps a dramatic or romantic narrative.
The man's pose and expression convey a sense of cool confidence and detachment.
The vintage car and boombox establish a retro aesthetic, contrasting with the modern feel of the man's styling.
reuseFormula: Generate a full-body shot of a man in dark attire and sunglasses, leaning casually against a vintage teal/blue car. The car's door should be open, with a large quantity of vibrant red roses spilling out onto the ground. A silver boombox should be placed on the car's trunk. The lighting should be slightly desaturated to enhance a moody atmosphere, with the red roses providing a strong color contrast. Add a black rectangular box in the bottom-left corner containing white, uppercase, condensed sans-serif text 'PARENTAL ADVISORY' and 'EXPLICIT CONTENT'.
